title: ModelEvidence
description: Catalog row model-evidence 1.0.0: the evidence behind model-metrics, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/stages/train.py and evaluate.py under data/derived/models/: a training record (<slot>-training.json), a rejected-candidate record (<slot>-rejected.json, <slot>-2d-rejected.json) or the per-target evaluation detail (evaluation-detail.json, keyed by slot). The records are free-form beyond these keys: they hold the configuration, the held-out hash and the measured values a reader re-checks.
